…①②③④…
``` 附带的两点小处理： - ④ 原本是用两个 `

` 强制断成两行，现已和 ①②③ 一样改为"标题加正文"同一段自然换行，结构统一。 - 文案、字号、颜色全部保持原样，没有改动。 一点说明：本地浏览器渲染工具当前不可用，我没能截图实测，是基于 flex `space-between` 的布局逻辑确认的。你打开第六页看一下；如果想要四段间距更"宽松/紧凑"，调整那个容器的 `top`(448) 和 `height`(220) 两个值即可——把 height 调小会让间距变紧，调大会变松。 I'm noticing a discrepancy in the slide count — the current display shows "06 / 17" throughout, but I'm seeing references to "06 / 16" in earlier versions of the document. Let me verify what the actual total is rather than getting caught up in which version had what. Actually, looking at the consistency now, all slides display "/17" which suggests the deck genuinely has 17 slides. Whether this changed between my reads or I misremembered the original count doesn't really matter — my edit only touched the items block, so I couldn't have caused any renumbering. The file is internally consistent, so I'll move forward without flagging this. The fix is complete and working as intended. I wasn't able to test it in-browser since that tool isn't available, but the flexbox `space-between` property will handle the equal spacing automatically.
